./.title: Nginx
./.body: Nginx Nginx 是一个高性能的 HTTP 和反向代理服务器。

docs/安装使用.html.title: 安装使用
docs/安装使用.html.body: 安装使用 要了解更多选择， Nginx 官方网站上有基于各种版本的 安装步骤 。

docs/常用命令.html.title: 常用命令
docs/常用命令.html.body: 常用命令 执行下面的命令，查看 Nginx 服务器版本号。 nginx -v 执行下面的命令，检查 Nginx 配置文件语法是否正确。 nginx -t 执行下面的命令，启动 Nginx 服务。 nginx 执行下面的命令，关闭 Nginx 服务。 nginx -s stop 执行下面的命令，重新加载 Nginx 服务。 nginx -s reload

docs/路径匹配.html.title: 路径匹配
docs/路径匹配.html.body: 路径匹配 精确匹配要求请求路径必须和配置路径完全一致才会命中，修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location = /admin { try_files /foo.html =404; } location = /admin/ { try_files /bar.html =404; } } } 前缀优先匹配要求请求路径的开头部分和配置路径的前缀一致，修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location ^~ /admin { try_files /foo.html =404; } location ^~ /admin/user { try_files /bar.html =404; } } } 正则匹配通过正则表达式匹配请求路径，修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location ~ \.JPG$ { try_files /foo.html =404; } location ~* \.jpg$ { try_files /bar.html =404; } } } 普通前缀匹配优先级低于正则匹配，修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location /admin { try_files /foo.html =404; } location /admin/user { try_files /bar.html =404; } } } 通用匹配优先级最低，只适用于所有路径匹配都未命中的情况，修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location / { index index.html; } } }

docs/访问认证.html.title: 访问认证
docs/访问认证.html.body: 访问认证 通过配置 auth_request 子请求认证，能够让 Nginx 在收到指定类型的业务请求时，先向独立的认证服务发起内部子请求，根据子请求的响应状态来决定是否放行。修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location /admin { auth_request /auth; try_files /admin.html =404; } location = /auth { internal; # proxy_pass http://www.example.com/auth_check; # proxy_pass_request_body off; # proxy_set_header Content-Length ""; # proxy_set_header X-Original-URI $request_uri; # proxy_set_header X-Original-Method $request_method; # proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; return 200; # return 401; } } }

docs/流量控制.html.title: 流量控制
docs/流量控制.html.body: 流量控制 限制单个客户端同时建立的活跃连接数量，主要用于防止单用户通过多线程下载、多连接占用耗尽服务器连接资源。修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=ip_conn:10m; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location /download { limit_conn ip_conn 1; limit_conn_status 429; try_files /download.html =404; } } } 基于漏桶算法限制单位时间内的请求数量，是生产环境中最常用的限流手段，主要用于防 CC 攻击、防爬虫、防接口被高频恶意调用。修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=ip_req:10m rate=1r/s; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location /api { limit_req zone=ip_req burst=2 nodelay; limit_req_status 429; try_files /api.html =404; } } } 限制单个连接的下载或传输速度，从而控制出口带宽占用。修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=ip_conn:10m; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location /download { limit_conn ip_conn 1; limit_conn_status 429; limit_rate_after 1m; limit_rate 100k; try_files /download.html =404; } } } 允许或限制指定单个 IP 或网段访问相关资源。修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; root /usr/share/nginx/html; location /admin { allow 127.0.0.1; allow 192.168.0.0/16; deny all; try_files /admin.html =404; } location /user { deny 123.45.67.89; allow all; try_files /user.html =404; } } }

docs/虚拟主机.html.title: 虚拟主机
docs/虚拟主机.html.body: 虚拟主机 还可以通过配置端口号访问指定的 Web 服务，修改 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 8001; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html/8001; index index.html index.htm; } } server { listen 8002; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html/8002; index index.html index.htm; } } }

docs/配置文件.html.title: 配置文件
docs/配置文件.html.body: 配置文件 针对生产环境进行调优的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; # error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log; error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log warn; # error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log notice; # error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log info; pid /var/run/nginx.pid; worker_rlimit_nofile 65535; events { use epoll; worker_connections 10240; multi_accept on; accept_mutex off; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" ' '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" ' '"$http_user_agent" "$http_x_forwarded_for"'; sendfile on; tcp_nopush on; tcp_nodelay on; keepalive_timeout 65; send_timeout 10s; client_header_timeout 15s; client_body_timeout 15s; proxy_connect_timeout 5s; proxy_read_timeout 30s; proxy_send_timeout 30s; proxy_buffering on; gzip on; gzip_comp_level 4; gzip_min_length 1k; gzip_vary on; gzip_disable "MSIE [1-6]\."; gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript text/xml application/xml application/xml+rss text/javascript; server_tokens off; client_max_body_size 10m; limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=req_limit:10m rate=100r/s; limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=conn_limit:10m; server { listen 80; server_name example.com www.example.com; return 301 https://$host$request_uri; } server { listen 443 ssl http2; server_name example.com www.example.com; root /usr/share/nginx/html; access_log /var/log/nginx/example.com_access.log main buffer=32k flush=5s; ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/example.com.crt; ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/example.com.key; ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5:!RC4:!DHE; ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on; ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m; ssl_session_timeout 1d; ssl_session_tickets off; add_header X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN always; add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always; add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always; add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always; add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always; location / { index index.html index.htm; } error_page 404 /404.html; error_page 500 502 503 504 /50x.html; location ~* \.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|css|js|woff2?)$ { add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=2592000, immutable" always; add_header X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN always; add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always; add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always; add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always; add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always; } location /nginx_status { stub_status on; allow 127.0.0.1; deny all; access_log off; } location ~* /\.ht { deny all; access_log off; } } }

docs/反向代理.html.title: 反向代理
docs/反向代理.html.body: 反向代理 修改反向代理服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { proxy_pass http://backend-server; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } } } 修改后端服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; } } } 重启 Nginx 服务后，即可将请求反向代理至后端服务器。

docs/负载均衡.html.title: 负载均衡
docs/负载均衡.html.body: 负载均衡 普通轮询 加权轮询 IP 哈希 最少连接数 状态控制 普通轮询 使用轮询策略来转发请求，按请求到达的时间顺序，逐一轮流分配到每台后端服务器。修改反向代理服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; upstream backend-server-pool { server backend-server-foo; server backend-server-bar; server backend-server-baz; } server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { proxy_pass http://backend-server-pool; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } } } 分别修改后端服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; } } } 加权轮询 使用加权轮询策略来转发请求，权重越高，分配给指定服务器的请求就越多。修改反向代理服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; upstream backend-server-pool { server backend-server-foo weight=3; server backend-server-bar weight=2; server backend-server-baz weight=1; } server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { proxy_pass http://backend-server-pool; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } } } 分别修改后端服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; } } } IP 哈希 使用 IP 哈希策略来转发请求，同一个 IP 的请求永远分配到同一台后端服务器，会话天然粘滞。修改反向代理服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; upstream backend-server-pool { ip_hash; server backend-server-foo; server backend-server-bar; server backend-server-baz; } server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { proxy_pass http://backend-server-pool; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } } } 分别修改后端服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; } } } 最少连接数 使用最少连接数策略来转发请求，每次新请求到来时，动态分配给当前活跃连接数最少的后端服务器。修改反向代理服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; upstream backend-server-pool { least_conn; server backend-server-foo; server backend-server-bar; server backend-server-baz; } server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { proxy_pass http://backend-server-pool; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } } } 分别修改后端服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; } } } 状态控制 还可以控制后端服务器的状态、故障转移、限流等行为。修改反向代理服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; upstream backend-server-pool { server backend-server-foo weight=3 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s; server backend-server-bar weight=2 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s; server backend-server-baz weight=1 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s; server backend-server-qux backup max_fails=2 fail_timeout=30s; } server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { proxy_pass http://backend-server-pool; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } } } 分别修改后端服务器的 nginx.conf 配置文件内容如下。 user nginx; worker_processes auto; events { worker_connections 1024; } http { include mime.types; default_type application/octet-stream; server { listen 80; server_name localhost; location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; } } }

docs/高可用部署.html.title: 高可用部署
docs/高可用部署.html.body: 高可用部署 准备好两台 Nginx 服务器，分别执行下面的命令，在 Ubuntu 系统中安装 Keepalived 服务。 sudo apt-get install keepalived 安装完成后，执行下面的命令检查 Keepalived 服务运行状态。 sudo systemctl status keepalived 分别在两台服务器中创建脚本文件 /etc/keepalived/check_nginx.sh 内容如下。 #!/bin/bash LOG_FILE="/var/log/check_nginx.log" NGINX_PORT=80 FAIL_FLAG="/tmp/nginx_start_fail.flag" if [ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then touch "$LOG_FILE" chmod 777 "$LOG_FILE" fi log() { echo "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $1" >> "$LOG_FILE" } check_nginx_process() { if ps -ef | grep -v grep | grep -q "nginx: master process"; then return 0 else return 1 fi } check_nginx_port() { if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$NGINX_PORT" | grep -q "200\|301\|302"; then return 0 else return 1 fi } start_nginx() { log "尝试启动 Nginx..." systemctl start nginx sleep 3 } log "===== 开始检测 Nginx 状态 =====" if [ -f "$FAIL_FLAG" ]; then log "检测到 Nginx 启动失败标记文件，关闭 Keepalived 触发 VIP 切换." systemctl stop keepalived exit 1 fi if check_nginx_process && check_nginx_port; then if [ -f "$FAIL_FLAG" ]; then rm -f "$FAIL_FLAG" log "Nginx 恢复正常，删除失败标记文件." fi log "Nginx 运行正常." exit 0 else log "Nginx 未正常运行，开始处理..." start_nginx if check_nginx_process && check_nginx_port; then log "Nginx 重新启动成功." exit 0 else touch "$FAIL_FLAG" log "Nginx 启动失败，创建标记文件,关闭 Keepalived 触发 VIP 切换." systemctl stop keepalived exit 1 fi fi 然后给创建好的脚本文件添加执行权限。 sudo chmod +x /etc/keepalived/check_nginx.sh 修改主节点服务器的 /etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf 配置文件如下。 vrrp_script check_nginx { script "/etc/keepalived/check_nginx.sh" interval 5 weight -20 } vrrp_instance VI_1 { state MASTER interface ens33 virtual_router_id 51 priority 100 advert_int 1 authentication { auth_type PASS auth_pass 1111 } virtual_ipaddress { 192.168.10.100 } track_script { check_nginx } } 修改备节点服务器的 /etc/keepalived/keepalived.conf 配置文件如下。 vrrp_script check_nginx { script "/etc/keepalived/check_nginx.sh" interval 5 weight -20 } vrrp_instance VI_1 { state BACKUP interface ens33 virtual_router_id 51 priority 80 advert_int 1 authentication { auth_type PASS auth_pass 1111 } virtual_ipaddress { 192.168.10.100 } } 先关闭 Nginx 服务，随后重启 Keepalived 服务，再分别执行 /etc/keepalived/check_nginx.sh 脚本文件。一切配置已准备就绪，执行下面的命令，配置成功的情况下只有主节点服务器中有虚拟 IP ，而备节点服务器中则没有，通过访问虚拟 IP 即可查看效果。 ip addr 在主节点服务器中执行下面的命令，模拟主节点服务器故障。 sudo systemctl stop keepalived sudo systemctl stop nginx 此时，主节点服务器发生故障，系统将自动切换到备节点服务器。而当故障恢复后，则会自动切换回至主节点。
